seo.title: How Much Is a Haircut? Barber FAQ in Carlsbad, NM
seo.description: Straight answers from Tim at Divinely Faded in Carlsbad, NM: haircut prices, hours, Saturdays, holidays, payment, kids and how long each service takes.
seo.primary: how much is a haircut carlsbad nm
secondary: barbers open on sunday near me
what to ask for at the barber

paragraphs: Straight answers on booking, hours, prices and what happens in the chair. If yours isn't here, text me.

items.a: Yes. Divinely Faded is appointment only, and every booking goes through Booksy. Pick your service, pick your time, and you're set.
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 9:00 AM to noon and again from 12:30 to 5:00 PM [TIM?]. Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
Yes, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. It's the one weekend day I cut.

items.q: Are you open Sunday or Wednesday?
items.a: No. The shop is closed every Wednesday and every Sunday.
Yes, on my normal schedule for that day of the week. If you book on the holiday itself, there's a {{holiday_fee}} holiday fee on top of the service.
Text {{phone}}. I'd rather get a text than a call, but calls work too.

The Essential Haircut is {{price:essential-haircut}}. The Signature Cut, which includes a beard trim or line-up and a hot towel finish, is {{price:signature-cut}}. The Luxury Grooming Experience is {{price:luxury-grooming}}. Every service and add-on is listed on the services page.
I take cash, card, Zelle and Cash App. You pay in full after your service, not before.

items.q: What happens if I miss my appointment or cancel late?
items.a: No-shows and late cancellations may be charged a cancellation fee through Booksy. If something comes up, cancel on Booksy as early as you can.
Yes, kids are welcome. Book them on Booksy the same way you'd book yourself.

items.q: How long does each service take?
items.a: Essential Haircut {{minutes:essential-haircut}}. Signature Cut {{minutes:signature-cut}}. Luxury Grooming Experience {{minutes:luxury-grooming}}. Straight Razor Beard Shave {{minutes:straight-razor-beard-shave}}. Head & Beard Shave {{minutes:head-beard-shave}}. Express Facial {{minutes:express-facial}}. Deluxe Facial {{minutes:deluxe-facial}}. Braids {{minutes:braids}}. Perm {{minutes:perm}}. Color Transformation {{minutes:color-transformation}}.

A photo of the cut you want does most of the talking. Tell me how short you want the sides, how much to leave on top, and whether the beard needs work, because a beard trim or line-up means booking the Signature Cut.
Booksy holds {{minutes:braids}} for braids, and the price varies with the style you choose.
No. Beard dyeing and capillary treatments aren't on my menu. Toupee services are coming soon.

tim_questions: [TIM?] Confirm weekday hours (Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 9:00 AM–12:00 PM and 12:30–5:00 PM per Booksy).

Does a beard trim or line-up always mean the Signature Cut, or can it be added another way? (The 'What should I ask for' answer says to book the Signature Cut for beard work, which matches the Booksy menu.)
